title: Performing under deadline pressure
opening_case: A volunteer will give a 2-minute briefing and fears a missed sentence.

nodes.prompt: A volunteer will give a 2-minute briefing and fears a missed sentence. Choose your first response.

choices.text: Rehearse a recovery line for an interruption
choices.rationale: This preserves a possible evidence-gathering route.

choices.text: Practice with a brief simulated question
choices.rationale: This is another plausible route; later options may change the result.

nodes.prompt: You lose your place midway. What next?

choices.text: Return to the last key point and continue
choices.rationale: Consider practical limits, context and autonomy.

choices.text: Quit because the practice was not flawless
choices.rationale: Consider whether a broad interpretation exceeds the evidence.

nodes.prompt: A question is harder than expected. Next?

choices.text: State what you know and offer to verify the rest
choices.rationale: Consider whether an additional observation is possible.

choices.text: Invent a confident answer to keep momentum
choices.rationale: Consider what remains unknown and who else is affected.
